results.name: A guest with no draft yet gets an honest empty draft (version 0)
First draft save succeeds and returns version 1
Reloading the draft returns the exact last-saved data
A stale-version write (version 1, server is at 2) is rejected 409, not silently applied
Completion with no selection is rejected 400, not silently accepted
Completion with a fabricated (non-existent) cigar id is rejected 400, never trusted
A real, valid selection completes successfully and grants server-decided XP
A second completion attempt (even with a different selection) is honestly rejected as already-completed, no double XP
Both concurrent completion requests return well-formed success (no 500)
A two-tab completion race grants XP exactly once, not twice
A completely separate guest never sees another guest's draft (honest empty state, not c1's data)
Saving a draft alone (never calling /complete) awards zero XP
